summary: This round's only source change makes `FilesystemService.writeAt` loop over short writes. Each retry advances both the buffer offset and the file position by `bytesWritten`, and a zero-byte write returns an error instead of looping forever. The logic is correct. A new temp test simulates 3-byte writes and checks that the staged file contents are complete. It then forces zero-byte writes and checks that the upload fails. All test runs pass and the coverage gate passes with the exemptions I already accepted, so no P0 or P1 issues remain.
